releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.11 — your editable profile. Tapping the profile card at the top of Settings now opens the Profile page: a large avatar with a camera button, the Name and About rows you can edit in place with Save and Cancel, and the read-only Username and Phone rows. Changing the photo opens the real system photo picker and then the Move and Scale cropper from the reference — drag to reposition, pinch or use the slider and +/- buttons to zoom between 100% and 400%, double-tap to snap-zoom, rotate in 90° steps and confirm with the gradient check; the circle you framed is what gets saved. Your new name, bio and photo appear everywhere in the app straight away.
